verbs.name: ui.state
verbs.description: Revisioned, path-safe state from the connected UI: active workspace and left/right/review tabs, overlays/dialogs, available and agent-openable surface ids, playhead, selection, export range, safe project identity, the currently rendered About version when its visible text has committed, the operating-system dialogs the app waits behind (overlays.native_dialogs), the record shortcut registration (record_hotkey) and the person-facing notices shown now (notices). Errors no_ui_client after the last UI socket disconnects.
verbs.result: {schema:'shellx-cut/ui-state/2', connected:true, ui_clients, state_revision, active_workspace, left, right:{collapsed,pinned,active_tab,body_status:'loaded'|'loading'|'blocked'|'failed'|null,recovery_selector:string|null}, review, about?:{displayed_version:string|null}, preview?:{media_problem:{kind:'cannot_decode',asset_ids,message}|null, mode:'composed'|'live', showing:'composed_frame'|'live_preview'|'source_frame'|'none', hidden_elements, media:'proxy'|'original'|null, composed_frame:{state,at_ms,reason,latency_ms,requests}|null}, overlays:{wizard,settings,comments,drawer,highlight,dialogs,native_dialogs:[{kind:'open'|'save'|'confirm'|'message',opened_by,title?}], quit_question:{message, running:string[], choices:['keep_working','quit_and_stop']}|null}, record_hotkey:{state,scope,reason}, export_folder:{destination:'chosen'|'project_exports',usable,folder:name|null}|null, notices:[{kind:'action_feedback'|'odd_project_size'|'recording_recovery'|'recording_recovery_more'|'failed_job'|'failed_jobs_more',...}], open_surface_ids, available_surface_ids, agent_openable_surface_ids, playhead_ms, selected_clip_ids, export_range?, project:{open,name?,active_sequence?}}

verbs.name: ui.screenshot
verbs.description: Ask the connected UI client to capture itself. returns {path, mime}; inline:true adds base64. Errors no_ui_client when no UI is connected, or job_failed when the UI returns no image or invalid base64.
verbs.result: {path, mime, base64?, notes?} — notes? rides along when panels were composited from live pixels
